killedBy: the developer modules load when the pane opens (issue #1014) Copy, when the clipboard refuses pressed before the load still selects its report when it lands, and the refusal escapes nowhere
why: Issue #1014. A refused clipboard write escapes as an unhandled rejection, which `boot.ts` treats as the match failing. A Copy answered after the load can outlive the press's user activation, which is exactly when a browser refuses; jsdom has no clipboard, so no case before #1014 could see this.
